_approach: The wheel-up moment: a dry, clipped gunshot-snare rolls denser bar to bar on a 32nd grid — short decay, low sustain, per MusicRadar's grime production tips — before hard-stopping into silence, the exact cue a DJ or MC calls a reload on in a clash set. Ref: MusicRadar '22 pro grime production tricks'; DJ TechTools 'Reload: A History of The Rewind'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
